roadmap.label: soldering os confidential computing
roadmap.mesh: nodes attest · workloads stay encrypted · zk compute

phases.title: the loop
phases.isolates: a single function — one trusted app
phases.protects: secure world hidden from the normal world and from root
phases.runs: key generation, rsa + aes, small payloads
phases.desc: inside the secure world, an incoming frame is decrypted, inverted, and returned; the keypair generated on-chip.
phases.detail: the secure world generates an rsa keypair and holds the private half on-die. the client wraps an aes key under rsa and the frame under aes; inside trustzone both are unwrapped, the frame decrypted, inverted, and returned. the encrypt-process-return loop runs end to end on the board.

phases.title: the anon
phases.isolates: the agent's code — one trusted app
phases.protects: the agent's code and key, sealed on-die
phases.proves: genuine code on genuine hardware — anonymously
phases.runs: an agent, anonymous attestation, group signatures
phases.desc: an agent whose code the hardware proves genuine and unaltered. behavior verifiable, operator anonymous.
phases.detail: the agent is sealed in the secure world and signs its outputs with a key locked on-die. on challenge it proves which code it runs and that the chip is genuine, using anonymous attestation: confirmation that a real node runs exactly this code, without revealing which node or who operates it. the code and the hardware are verified, never an identity.

phases.title: the box
phases.hardware: amd epyc 7003 'milan' · sp3 board · ecc rdimm · sev-snp
phases.isolates: a whole vm — a full linux
phases.protects: per-vm encrypted memory; hypervisor, host os and root all blind
phases.proves: remote attestation rooted in the amd secure processor
phases.desc: a whole linux runs in cpu-encrypted memory; the host reads only ciphertext.
phases.detail: sev-snp encrypts the vm's entire memory in hardware and adds secure nested paging for integrity. a normal linux with normal ffmpeg or a model server runs inside; the hypervisor, the host os and root see only ciphertext. the minimum is milan (epyc 7003) — rome and naples have sev but not snp.

phases.title: the gpu
phases.hardware: amd epyc 7003 'milan' · sev-snp · nvidia h100 · h200 · gpu tee
phases.isolates: vm and gpu in one chain of trust
phases.protects: ciphertext across cpu and gpu memory
phases.proves: gpu attestation joins the confidential vm's
phases.runs: encrypted video transcoding, distributed across nodes
phases.desc: encrypted video is transcoded on the gpu inside the enclave and returned as ciphertext; the work distributes across nodes, none seeing the content.
phases.detail: video arrives as ciphertext and is decrypted only inside the gpu enclave, transcoded there, and re-encrypted before it leaves. the same job spreads across a decentralized network of nodes; on each one the plaintext exists only inside the enclave.

phases.title: the swarm
phases.isolates: one job per enclave, per node
phases.protects: every input, output and workload as ciphertext
phases.proves: every node attests before taking a job
phases.desc: encrypted jobs run across a network of confidential nodes; each returns only the result the client asked for and wipes everything else.
phases.detail: a job enters as ciphertext, runs inside an enclave on whichever node takes it, and returns only what the client needs. inputs, intermediate state, and the agent's memory are wiped when the job ends. the work spreads across the network, and no node retains the content.

phases.title: the mixer
phases.isolates: the link between sender, runner and payer
phases.protects: payments, routing and on-chain calls, all unlinkable
phases.proves: validity by zero-knowledge proof, no identity revealed
phases.runs: anonymous payments, routing and on-chain calls
phases.desc: a zk mixer breaks the link between who submits a job, who runs it and who pays; on-chain calls are anonymized the same way.
phases.detail: zero-knowledge proofs replace identity: a job's validity, a payment, an on-chain call are proven without revealing who made them. a mixing pool re-routes value and requests so submitter, runner and payer stay unlinkable. on-chain functions pass through the same layer and are anonymized too.
